E': Electric field in the test charge's frame
F: Magnetic force on the charge in the lab
F': Electric force in the test charge's frame
beta: Speed as a fraction of c
beta_u: Test charge's speed as a fraction of c
beta_v: Electrons' speed as a fraction of c
lambda': Net line density in the test charge's frame
lambda_0: Line charge density of the ions in the lab (the electrons have −λ₀)
lambda_rest: Line density in the line's own rest frame
r: Distance of the test charge from the wire
u: Speed of the test charge along the wire
v: Drift speed of the electrons in the lab
w: Speed of a line of charge
